# Helvety Links

> Encrypted bookmarks in nested folders you control. Names and URLs are encrypted on your device before storage. Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Links App](https://helvety.com/links): Auth-required bookmarks route

## Crawling And Indexing
- Links routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and are protected by noindex metadata and authentication controls.
